segments.he: מרבינו ז"ל שראה א' שהי' לו קריעה בבגדו על מתו ואמר לו שהעצבות (שהי' איש עצבן) גרם לו זאת הקריעה רח"ל היינו שמת לו מת (וכמובא בס' המדות שצריך ליזהר מעצבות שלא יבא לידי אבילו רח"ל).
segments.en: During the time of the height of the great controversy against Moharan'as — when the opponents issued a decree to destroy, kill, and annihilate all our fellowship — our fellowship suffered terribly, and it was a great miracle that all our fellowship were not killed then. A little of this is described in the letters of those years and in Yemei HaTela'os. And throughout that winter Moharan'as remained in Uman, afraid to return to Breslov lest they kill him. He was lodged at his companion Reb Naftali's home. Every day he went to Rabbainu's grave and prayed there for several hours. When he returned to Reb Naftali's home, he would ask for his letters [for his letters came to Reb Naftali's address]. When he read them he would say: "It seems I cannot yet return home" — for he could see from the letters that the controversy was still blazing stronger each time.
